Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.social

Class PendingIdentityLinks

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.social.PendingIdentityLinks
@Component public class PendingIdentityLinks extends Object
Keeps the link marker (PendingIdentityLink) of the explicit link flow: the identities page records it in the session before sending the browser to the provider, and the user services consume it when the provider sends the user back. The marker is used once and only within LIFETIME, only for the provider it names and only while the session is still signed in as the account that asked; otherwise the sign-in goes on as an ordinary one. When the marker is consumed, the authentication of the session is kept in a request attribute, so the success handler can put it back: linking never switches the session to another principal.

    • consume

      public Optional<PendingIdentityLink> consume(IdentityProvider provider)
      Consumes the marker of the current request, if it is usable for a sign-in with a provider. The marker is removed whether or not it is usable.
      Parameters:
      provider - the provider the user just signed in with.
      Returns:
      the marker, or empty when there is none, it expired, it names another provider or the session is no longer signed in as the account that asked.
